shortDescription: 10-week six-day push, pull, legs hypertrophy program.
descriptionHtml:
10-week six-day push, pull, legs hypertrophy program.

Structure: 10 weeks, 7 scheduled sessions per week, 65 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Day 1 - Push, Day 2 - Pull, Day 3 - Legs, Day 4 - Push, Day 5 - Pull, Day 6 - Legs, and Abs.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 10 weeks
  • Tags: push pull legs and 6 days per week
